color.note: Neutral cool greys, one cobalt accent. Green and red appear only on signed money amounts.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards, the sidebar and the tab bar sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, header, tab bar, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Read-only fields, table header rows, segmented-control track, progress track, neutral chips.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover and pressed state on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards (decorative, not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and select borders, unchecked controls: 3:1 or more on surface and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and neutral amounts, on bg, surface and surface-sunken (15:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, helper text, captions, inactive tab labels, on bg, surface and surface-sunken (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast); never for information.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent (cobalt): primary button fill, active nav, links, focus ring, progress fill, Aplicată chip text. As text on bg, surface, accent-soft (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover/pressed.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav background, Aplicată chip and saving-bucket icon backgrounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button label); dark in the dark theme because the accent lightens.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive money only: contributions (always with +) and a remainder ≥ 0. As text on bg, surface, positive-soft (4.7:1+).

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind a positive amount badge.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative money only: withdrawals and a remainder < 0 (always with −), over-allocation. As text on bg, surface, negative-soft (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind a negative amount badge and the destructive confirm area.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dialog and sheet backdrop.

families.sans: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Cifre
groups.note: Amounts always use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one hero balance on a desktop bucket detail.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: Hero amounts on mobile: bucket balance, Rămas de împărțit.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Card totals: Venit lunar, sold on a bucket card, KPI tiles.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family; Inter when available, the system UI face otherwise.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles (desktop top bar, bucket detail).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Card and section titles; the month name in the header.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, row names, input values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Amounts in rows, button labels, emphasised names.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table headers, chips, secondary amounts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper text, metadata, dates in lists.

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile gutter space-4, desktop page padding space-8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between stacked fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter, card padding on mobile, row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Login card padding (desktop), large section breaks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top offset of the desktop page title.

radius.note: Soft corners; pills only for chips, progress bars and the segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, kbd, tiny tags.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, icon buttons, nav items, segmented-control segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and the table container.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Login card, dialogs, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips, progress bars, avatars.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button and input height (touch target) on mobile and desktop.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons, icon buttons, inline row inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Mobile app header and desktop top bar height.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar height (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop left sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-content
tokens.usage: Max width of desktop content area.

tokens.name: breakpoint-desktop
tokens.usage: At and above this viewport width, the sidebar replaces the tab bar.

shadow.note: Cards rely on a hairline first; shadows stay faint.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest (with the line border).

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, the sticky Aplică luna bar.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: 2px surface gap, then 2px solid accent.
